scenario: A harness whose native precedence lets user config override project config still cannot let a user setting weaken a managed mandatory control; where the harness cannot realize the invariant, the adapter declares it and the control moves to external enforcement.

adapter.managed_enforcement: user scope cannot disable managed hooks (verified)

when: the effective configuration is composed and inspected

reasons: secret-scan remains active; the user-scope disable is reported as a rejected conflict with both zones named
the adapter's matrix entry for managed enforcement is cited as the guarantee
must_not: honor native user-over-project precedence for a managed mandatory control
hide the conflict because the outcome was correct
claim the invariant on a harness whose matrix records no managed enforcement — that case demands external layers instead
